text:
ryan: planning a quiet-window flip for the session-affinity header -> cookie migration. target window 2025-08-02T01:00:00Z, 10m. need pins + rollback rules across api, runtime, router, console. proposed pins: api:v1.5.0, runtime:kernel-b16, router:affinity-cookie, console:ui-4.2.0. who can own watch?

deploy-bot: scheduled release wave rd-90211 for 2025-08-02T01:00:00Z (10m window). contributors tagged. :robot_face:

leila: runtime note — kernel-b16 enables readahead on KV lookups; should reduce p50 but might regress p99 under high concurrency. recommend kernel-b15 for the window unless we run a short perf spike test.

omar: router: affinity-cookie branch rewrites routing to prefer _s_aff cookie over X-Session header. backward compatible but there's a sniff test: old clients set X-Session only. i can add a switch to fall back to header for unknown cookies.

camille: console: ui-4.2.0 surfaces session buckets; if cookie appears we show new bucket UI. please gate telemetry so we don't flood vanity dashboards. request: route metric -> session.bucket = "legacy" when fallback used.

ryan: action items: 1) runtime pin decision; 2) router fallback guard; 3) console telemetry gating; 4) release notes + playbook. Rollback thresholds?

leila: propose rollback if: 1) route-5xx increases >0.5% sustained 4m OR 2) p99 latency > baseline + 200ms sustained 3m OR 3) error budget burn > 10% in window. Also: if console missing-buckets > 0.5% of requests, revert UI.

omar: added fallback switch to router.staging; tested curl variations:
```
# header-only
curl -s -H "X-Session: abc" https://router.staging/route | jq .route
# cookie-only
curl -s --cookie "_s_aff=xyz" https://router.staging/route | jq .route
```
responses: both return route=ok.

deploy-bot: wave rd-90211 executing: api:v1.5.0@sha=aa11bb, runtime:kernel-b15@sha=cc22dd, router:affinity-cookie+fallback@sha=ee33ff, console:ui-4.2.0-gated@sha=gg44hh. Canary jobs started.

monitor-bot: canary metrics snapshot (pre-deploy): p50=42ms, p95=120ms, p99=210ms, route-5xx=0.02%. Baseline saved.

camille: enabled telemetry gate -> session.bucket="legacy" when fallback. muting non-actionable badges for 15m.

ryan: manual watchlist: ryan (overall), leila (runtime), omar (router), camille (console). On call list pinged. If thresholds hit, ping oncall and trigger rollback with deploy-bot revert command.

leila: running a 2-minute load spike on staging to validate kernel-b15 p99 behavior. will comment results.

leila: spike looks ok — p99 down ~10ms vs b16 under similar load. i'll keep b15 pinned for the window.

deploy-bot: quiet window lock by @ryan for 10m starting 2025-08-02T01:00:00Z. contact list: ryan, leila, omar, camille.

ryan: final checklist ticked: release notes updated (see internal link), runbook attached, monitoring alerts created for p99/p95/route-5xx/session.bucket-drop. Remember: rollback command is `deploy-bot revert rd-90211 --to-shas aa11bb,cc22dd,ee33ff,gg44hh` if we need staged revert.

omar: LGTM — i'll monitor route funnels and enable immediate revert if cookie mismatch spikes.

camille: LGTM — will mute vanity alerts and watch session.bucket distribution.

leila: LGTM — watching runtime telemetry. will escalate to pager for p99 breach.

ryan: thanks all — flipping in 2m. will post outcome and short notes after the window. :white_check_mark:
